title: Range Sum of BST
description:
Given the root node of a binary search tree and two integers low and high , return the sum of values of all nodes with a value in the inclusive range [low, high] . 

 Example 1: 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2020/11/05/bst1.jpg] 
 
```
Input:
 root = [10,5,15,3,7,null,18], low = 7, high = 15

Output:
 32

Explanation:
 Nodes 7, 10, and 15 are in the range [7, 15]. 7 + 10 + 15 = 32.
```

 Example 2: 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2020/11/05/bst2.jpg] 
 
```
Input:
 root = [10,5,15,3,7,13,18,1,null,6], low = 6, high = 10

Output:
 23

Explanation:
 Nodes 6, 7, and 10 are in the range [6, 10]. 6 + 7 + 10 = 23.
```

 Constraints: 

 The number of nodes in the tree is in the range [1, 2 * 10 4 ] . 
 
 1 <= Node.val <= 10 5 
 
 1 <= low <= high <= 10 5 
 
 All Node.val are unique .
